question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Enormous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Enormous"** means something that is extremely large in size or amount. (विशाल)

 
 
• **Example: **The **enormous** elephant towered over the other animals in the zoo.
 
 
 
• **"Minute"** refers to something that is extremely small in size or amount. (बहुत छोटा)
 
 
• **Example: **She looked at the **minute** details of the painting through a magnifying glass.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'enormous' **is **'minute'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Strong **(मजबूत): Having the power to move heavy weights or perform other physically demanding tasks.

 
 
• **Example:** The strong man lifted the heavy weights with ease.
 
 
 
• **Tremendous **(विशाल): Very great in amount, scale, or intensity.
 
 
• **Example: **She made a tremendous effort to finish the project on time.
 
 
 
• **Monstrous** (राक्षसी): Having the ugly or frightening appearance of a monster.
 
 
• **Example:** The monstrous creature lurked in the shadows.
 
 

41:Tbce,

The correct answer is: Option 4
